purpose: Independent practice of D2.2 mean+mode prediction.
student_learning_goal: I can predict if mean and mode stay the same across two populations.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can predict if mean and mode stay the same across two populations.
header.character_watermark: Maybe Mae the Cat in the top-right with a calculator and a question-mark hat. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 paired data sets, predict if MEAN will be same/different and MODE will be same/different.
parts.visual_layout: Four scenario boxes with two predict rows (mean and mode) and same/different circles each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 mean/mode prediction layout for likelihood worksheet, B&W line art. 4 scenarios with paired class data. Each scenario: 'Mean: SAME / DIFFERENT' and 'Mode: SAME / DIFFERENT' rows.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_PREDICT at Part 1: keywords name the mean/mode prediction task.

parts.answer_key: Sample predictions per data set; varies.

parts.student_instructions: For 2 of the data sets, calculate the MEAN and MODE for each class.
parts.visual_layout: Two compute panels with rows for total, count, mean, and mode for each population.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 mean+mode compute layout for likelihood worksheet, B&W line art. 2 panels. Each panel has Class A and Class B columns. Each column has rows: total, count, mean, mode. Calculator icon at top.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_CALC at Part 2: keywords name the calculate-total-and-count step for mean and mode.

parts.answer_key: Sample: Class A 1,1,2,3,5 → total 12, count 5, mean 2.4, mode 1.

parts.student_instructions: Compare prediction to result. Explain ONE.
parts.visual_layout: Sentence frame with a comparison line and an explanation block.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 result-comparison layout for likelihood worksheet. Sentence frame: 'I predicted MEAN would be ___ and MODE would be ___. The data showed MEAN ___ and MODE ___. My prediction was right or wrong because ___.' 4 lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_RESULT at Part 3: keywords name the right-or-wrong comparison.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write what 'similar' populations look like.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Formative — check mean+mode calculation accuracy.
